headline_findings: FORMAT COMPLIANCE: with_skill 0.980 vs baseline without_skill 0.554 across 13 program types. Paired McNemar on 390 cells: 170 with-only vs 5 baseline-only, exact p = 5.55e-44. The skill's structural value is real and large, and it holds on the widened eval set.
TECHNICAL CORRECTNESS: judged defect recall with_skill 0.849 vs baseline 0.826 (delta +2.3pp). Paired sign test 9 better / 8 worse / 9 ties over 26 pairs, exact p = 1.0. NO significant difference.

THE JUDGE LAYER HAS CEILINGED: 46/77 planted defects (60%) are scored full marks by BOTH arms. With both arms at ~0.85/0.83 there is almost no headroom, so the aggregate judge mean can no longer separate the configurations even in principle. The next round must raise defect difficulty, not sample size.
WHERE THE SKILL STILL WINS: eval-3-D3 (语义校核) +75pp; eval-7-D8 (金额计算) +75pp; eval-1-D1 (数据流) +50pp; eval-1-D2 (语义校核) +50pp; eval-3-D5 (语义校核) +50pp.

WHERE THE SKILL LOSES: eval-4-D2 (可编译性) -75pp; eval-9-D2 (CDS 语义) -50pp; eval-9-D6 (HTTP 资源) -50pp; eval-11-D2 (接口定义顺序) -50pp; eval-1-D4 (错误处理) -25pp. These are net-negative, i.e. the skill actively misleads on them — the highest-value targets for skill revision.

MOST SEVERE MISSES, kept apart because they mean opposite things. One arm scored zero: eval-4-D2 (可编译性) with=0.00/base=0.75 -- these are the skill's own regressions, not method gaps. Both arms scored zero: eval-10-D2 (事务处理); eval-13-D6 (单位格式) -- skill-independent gaps in the analysis method, which no revision to this skill can close. A further 8 are scored identically and below full marks by both arms.
KEYWORD ASSERTIONS A14-A23 REMAIN DEAD: every applicable cell scored 100% on both arms except A19 and A20. They measure token presence, not understanding, and cannot stand in for the LLM judge.
